mcp_runtime_snapshot.provenance: All bundled MCP files copied to this run before launch; actual copied bytes hashed and reread. Workspace rebuilds cannot change this copy.

original_final_report.packaged_bridge_manifest_provenance: Local package metadata; not cryptographic attestation of the serving process.

supplied_native_build_manifest.provenance: Caller-supplied local manifest; endpoint binding is not independently attested.

native_job_order_check.rationale: preordered-grid; native Unsorted order avoids repeating whole-job route optimization each cycle
native_job_order_check.interpretation: Actual native Unsorted job order is required for the already ordered sustained grid; default-profile ordering and physical throughput are separate.

loaded_bridge_binding.provenance: Native Bridge.class code-source JAR digest matched to the locally verified packaged JAR.

retention.request_receipts: retained until journal capacity; then fail closed
retention.artifacts: bytes stored on disk and read on demand; aggregate content cap 1 GiB fails admission without deleting evidence; preserved until explicit state-directory cleanup
retention.plans: five-minute TTL and 128 maximum; old plans expire

simulator_attestation.job_order_rationale: preordered-grid; native Unsorted order avoids repeating whole-job route optimization each cycle

limitations: Only an isolated OpenPnP default simulator may mutate
Native step journal does not prove every irreversible substep
No physical machine profile is qualified

failure.message: The local OpenPnP bridge could not be reached or returned an invalid response.

soft_skips.reason: Paired get_status latency does not measure native-versus-MCP placement-cycle overhead; that controlled experiment is separate.
Java heap and optional total JVM RSS are measured. Native image allocations are not independently attributed.
This run measures growth and enforces declared caps; retained journal/artifacts are preserved, not purged to manufacture steady state. Offline failure replay is a separate test.
The fixture is virtual finite supply and one 150 mm board. Physical inspection and maximum panel depth are separate qualification work.
